about: Real-machine render plots for the c164 test world (a flat void server, 127.0.0.1:25599). Each test scene / work package is placed on its own plot so scenes never touch; the master (integration) scene sits on plot 0. A plot's origin is base + index*spacing on +X, and is passed unchanged to both place.py --at and shoot.py --origin, so shot lists written in scene coordinates line up. The render station (S1) owns this file. A scene that is shot before it is in this table gets the next free index from the shuttle, which notes it in the test world (datapacks/c164art/plots.local.json) and says so; it is then added here with that index. Indices are never reused or reshuffled, so a package keeps its plot across runs.
